prompt: The attached image is a 240x242 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,242,false);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;
renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,121,-121,1,1300);
const s=.365,c=Math.sqrt(1-s*s);
ref.position.set(0,590*s,590*c);
ref.lookAt(0,0,0);
const V=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const P=(u,v,z)=>V(u-120,(121-v+s*z)/c,z);
const group=(parent,name)=>{const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=name;parent.add(g);return g};
function mat(col,rough=.9){return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col,roughness:rough})}
function mesh(parent,geometry,material,name){
 const m=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,material);m.name=name;parent.add(m);m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;return m;
}
const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,44,32);
function oval(parent,name,pos,radii,material){
 const o=mesh(parent,sphere,material,name);o.position.copy(pos);o.scale.set(...radii);return o;
}
function box(parent,name,pos,size,m){
 const o=mesh(parent,new THREE.BoxGeometry(...size),m,name);o.position.copy(pos);return o;
}
let seed=81927;
function random(){seed=(Math.imul(1664525,seed)+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296}
function texture(wood=false){
 const data=new Uint8Array(64*64*4);
 for(let y=0;y<64;y++){
  const line=random()*20;
  for(let x=0;x<64;x++){
   const a=wood?212+line+10*Math.sin(y*1.7+Math.sin(x*.07))+(random()-.5)*12:221+random()*34;
   const i=4*(x+64*y);data[i]=data[i+1]=data[i+2]=a;data[i+3]=255;
  }
 }
 const t=new THREE.DataTexture(data,64,64);t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;t.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;t.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;t.generateMipmaps=true;t.needsUpdate=true;t.repeat.set(wood?2:8,wood?3:5);return t;
}
const fuzz=texture();
function cloth(col){
 const m=mat(col);m.map=fuzz;m.bumpMap=fuzz;m.bumpScale=.23;return m;
}
const gold=cloth(0xffbd24),gold2=cloth(0xffc332),cream=cloth(0xffdfa3),paw=cloth(0x706050);
const lip=mat(0x52321a),socket=cloth(0x98846a),iris=mat(0x25221e,.65),black=mat(0x100f0f,.48);
function strand(parent,name,points,radii,m){
 const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points,false,'catmullrom',.45);
 const steps=Math.max(20,points.length*8),sides=24,frames=curve.computeFrenetFrames(steps,false);
 const verts=[],idx=[],uv=[];
 for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
  const f=i/steps,pt=curve.getPointAt(f),u=curve.getUtoTmapping(f)*(points.length-1),j=Math.min(points.length-2,Math.floor(u)),mix=u-j;
  const r=radii[j]*(1-mix)+radii[j+1]*mix;
  for(let k=0;k<=sides;k++){
   const a=2*Math.PI*k/sides,p=pt.clone().addScaledVector(frames.normals[i],r*Math.cos(a)).addScaledVector(frames.binormals[i],r*Math.sin(a));
   verts.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);uv.push(k/sides,f);
   if(i&&k){const n=i*(sides+1)+k;idx.push(n-sides-2,n-sides-1,n,n-sides-2,n,n-1)}
  }
 }
 const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(verts,3));geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));geo.setIndex(idx);geo.computeVertexNormals();m.side=THREE.DoubleSide;return mesh(parent,geo,m,name);
}
const path=(parent,name,arr,rr,m)=>strand(parent,name,arr.map(q=>P(...q)),rr,m);
function rod(parent,name,a,b,r1,r2,m){
 const d=b.clone().sub(a),o=mesh(parent,new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r2,r1,d.length(),16),m,name);o.position.copy(a).lerp(b,.5);o.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,1,0),d.normalize());return o;
}
const characters=[];
function character(left){
 const g=group(scene,left?'character-left':'character-right');characters.push(g);
 const body=group(g,'torso'),head=group(g,'head');
 // Horizontal sections describe the continuous, gently leaning plush silhouette.
 const rows=left?[
 [58,211,4,4],[57,208,38,22],[55,191,53,33],[53,164,53,37],[52,141,48,34],[53,120,42,32],[55,102,39,30],[59,86,37,29],[63,71,32,26],[65,61,25,20],[66,55,16,14],[67,52,1,1]
 ]:[
 [181,211,4,5],[181,203,43,29],[179,186,61,39],[176,162,61,41],[169,137,57,36],[164,117,53,33],[158,98,47,31],[154,80,39,29],[151,64,32,25],[150,53,26,20],[148,46,18,14],[147,43,1,1]
 ];
 const z=left?0:-12,skin=left?gold:gold2;
 const curves=[0,1].map((_,i)=>new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(rows.map(r=>i?V(r[2],r[3],0):P(r[0],r[1],z)),false,'catmullrom',.35));
 function surface(parent,name,lo,hi){
  const pos=[],uv=[],idx=[],N=60,H=36;
  for(let j=0;j<=H;j++){
   const t=lo+(hi-lo)*j/H,p=curves[0].getPoint(t),r=curves[1].getPoint(t);
   for(let k=0;k<=N;k++){
    const a=k/N*Math.PI*2;pos.push(p.x+r.x*Math.sin(a),p.y,p.z+r.y*Math.cos(a));uv.push(k/N,t);
    if(j&&k){const n=j*(N+1)+k;idx.push(n-N-2,n-N-1,n,n-N-2,n,n-1)}
   }
  }
  const b=new THREE.BufferGeometry();b.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));b.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));b.setIndex(idx);b.computeVertexNormals();skin.side=THREE.DoubleSide;mesh(parent,b,skin,name);
 }
 surface(body,'rounded body',0,5/11);surface(head,'rounded crown',5/11,1);
 const belly=oval(body,'cream belly',P(left?62:185,left?179:171,z+24),left?[38,43,16]:[48,47,21],cream);belly.rotation.z=left?-.10:.26;
 const eyes=group(head,'eyes');
 const faces=left?[[52,90,27,10,10],[91,93,16,7,9]]:[[119,69,-1,5,8],[149,73,15,9,10]];
 faces.forEach(([u,v,d,w,h],i)=>{
  const eye=group(eyes,i?'eye-right':'eye-left'),center=P(u,v,d);
  oval(eye,'fabric eye surround',center,[w,h,7],socket);
  const dx=left?1.8:-2,dy=left?2:1;
  oval(eye,'dark iris',P(u+dx,v+dy,d+5),[w*.75,h*.81,4.2],iris);
  oval(eye,'pupil',P(u+dx+(left?.6:-.6),v+dy+.3,d+7.5),[w*.51,h*.56,2.8],black);
 });
 const mouth=group(head,'mouth');
 if(left)path(mouth,'small curved smile',[[62,109,29],[66,112,30],[71,113,30],[77,111,28]], [.18,1.1,1.1,.15],lip);
 else path(mouth,'smiling mouth',[[118,85,5],[123,88,11],[131,89,17],[140,87,19]],[.4,1.8,1.6,.15],lip);
 return {g,skin};
}
const L=character(true),R=character(false);
function arm(ch,name,arr,rr){const a=group(ch.g,name);path(a,'plush sleeve',arr,rr,ch.skin);return group(a,'hand')}
function hand(g,u,v,z,rx,ry,angle){
 const h=oval(g,'soft palm',P(u,v,z),[rx,ry,5.6],paw);h.rotation.z=angle;
}
let h=arm(L,'writing arm',[[18,121,0],[10,141,12],[5,167,24],[8,189,34],[17,201,41],[27,202,44]],[12,14,15,15,13,8]);
hand(h,35,204,48,12,9,.1);
for(let i=0;i<3;i++)path(h,'curled finger '+i,[[32+i*3,199-i,50],[38+i*3,202-i,54],[42+i*2,208-i*2,54]],[3.3,3,1.5],paw);
h=arm(L,'resting arm',[[90,125,1],[101,139,9],[111,159,18],[117,180,29],[113,191,32]],[10,11,10,9,7]);
hand(h,113,191,34,10,8,0);
for(let i=0;i<4;i++)path(h,'resting finger '+i,[[106+4*i,190,37],[104+4*i,195,40],[104+4*i,199-(i%3),41]],[2.8,2.8,1.4],paw);
h=arm(R,'far arm',[[133,103,-12],[121,113,-5],[113,118,3],[104,112,8]],[11,11,9,6]);
hand(h,101,112,9,7,5,-.7);
h=arm(R,'reaching arm',[[202,109,-4],[205,128,7],[196,147,18],[176,160,28],[151,166,36],[127,169,43],[110,171,45]],[15,20,21,20,17,13,9]);
hand(h,103,174,48,12,11,-.42);
const fingertips=[[84,164],[82,171],[84,178],[89,184]];
fingertips.forEach(([u,v],i)=>path(h,'outstretched finger '+i,[[103+i*.2,167+i*4,51],[94,167+i*4,54],[u+2,v,54],[u,v-.5,53]],[3.3,3.2,2.3,.8],paw));
path(h,'thumb',[[108,170,50],[108,164,52],[102,159,51],[98,159,50]],[3.7,3.6,2.6,1],paw);

const room=group(scene,'classroom'),wood=mat(0xc78948);wood.map=texture(true);
const darkwood=mat(0x654125),paper=mat(0xfff5dc),edges=mat(0xd9c7a6);
box(room,'warm plaster wall',V(0,45,-165),[780,340,9],mat(0xc4b8a8));
box(room,'chalkboard walnut frame',P(193,-31,-157),[234,137,7],darkwood);
box(room,'chalkboard',P(193,-31,-152),[223,127,4],mat(0x173d3b));
box(room,'rear chalk rail',P(192,32,-151),[230,3,7],mat(0x846746));
for(const [u,v,d,w] of [[19,96,-83,77],[208,87,-90,81],[246,106,-76,55]]){
 box(room,'background desk',P(u,v,d),[w,5,24],wood);
 for(const dx of [-.41,.41])box(room,'desk support',P(u+w*dx,v+29,d),[5,66,7],darkwood);
}
const desk=group(scene,'student desks');
const top=-66;
function onTable(u,v,y=top){return V(u-120,y,(121-v-c*y)/(-s))}
function table(name,u,v,w,depth,angle){
 const g=group(desk,name);g.position.copy(onTable(u,v));g.rotation.y=angle;
 box(g,'honey wood top',V(0,-3,0),[w,6,depth],wood);
 box(g,'front apron',V(0,-13,depth/2-6),[w-5,16,5],darkwood);
}
table('left desk',65,223,209,102,.08);table('right desk',219,201,119,111,-.28);
function book(name,cx,cy,width,depth,angle){
 const g=group(desk,name);g.position.copy(onTable(cx,cy,top+.2));g.rotation.y=angle;
 box(g,'umber cover',V(0,.5,0),[width+2,1,depth+2],darkwood);
 for(const sign of [-1,1]){
 const p=[],uv=[],ix=[],n=22;
 for(let k=0;k<=n;k++){
  const t=k/n,x=sign*t*width/2,y=2+4*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*Math.exp(-2*t)+1.7*t;
  for(const z of [-depth/2,depth/2]){p.push(x,y,z);uv.push(t,z>0?1:0)}
  if(k){const j=2*k;ix.push(j-2,j-1,j,j-1,j+1,j)}
 }
 const b=new THREE.BufferGeometry();b.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));b.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));b.setIndex(ix);b.computeVertexNormals();paper.side=THREE.DoubleSide;mesh(g,b,paper,'curved page');
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++)box(g,'page edges',V(sign*width/4,1+i*.65,0),[width/2,.62,depth],i===1?edges:paper);
 }
}
book('open exercise book',82,216,137,64,.31);
book('second exercise book',216,201,88,53,-.36);
const pencil=group(L.g,'writing pencil'),graphite=mat(0x383330),lacquer=mat(0xb6a28b);
const a=P(19,168,43),b=P(49,207,55),tip=P(54,214,57);
rod(pencil,'barrel',a,b,2,2,lacquer);rod(pencil,'exposed cedar',b,tip,2,.35,wood);rod(pencil,'lead',b.clone().lerp(tip,.72),tip,.7,.1,graphite);
function deskPen(u,v,U,W){
 const a=onTable(u,v,top+2),b=onTable(U,W,top+2);rod(desk,'pen shaft',a,b,1.5,1.5,graphite);rod(desk,'metal pen cap',a.clone().lerp(b,.62),b,1.7,1.5,lacquer);
}
deskPen(107,230,171,226);deskPen(174,214,223,224);deskPen(5,225,23,240);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff3e3,0xaf8765,1.45));
const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffeac7,2.25);key.position.set(-65,195,105);scene.add(key);key.castShadow=true;
Object.assign(key.shadow.camera,{left:-180,right:180,top:180,bottom:-180,near:1,far:500});key.shadow.mapSize.set(1024,1024);key.shadow.normalBias=.42;key.shadow.bias=-.00025;
const rim=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe6b9,1.25);rim.position.set(100,90,-55);scene.add(rim);
scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xc7b7a6);
function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref)}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
